_comment: Third-party Hugging Face datasets mirrored into harpreetsahota/grand-theft-gpu-assets. Each entry is pinned to an exact revision; 'include' lists the folder-name prefixes kept (people only: no animals, no children). Used by harness/mirror.py.

sources.creator: Microsoft (Microsoft Rocketbox Avatar Library, Copyright (c) 2020 Microsoft)
sources.what: Rigged 3D people: business, medical, police, fire, construction, pilots, sports, security, everyday adults
sources._exclude_items_why: Decided 2026-11-20: religious/culturally specific dress (female-adult-10, female-adult-16, male-adult-19, male-adult-21) is excluded so no model can cast those characters as spies or enemies in a satire with cartoon violence; swimwear (sports-female-01, sports-male-01) doesn't fit city streets.

sources.creator: Microsoft (Microsoft Rocketbox Avatar Library motion clips, Copyright (c) 2020 Microsoft)
sources.what: 326 motion-capture clips on the Rocketbox rig: idle, talking, sitting, phone calls, documents, dancing, cheering

sources.what: Low-poly city pieces: commercial, suburban, industrial buildings, roads, retro urban kit, modular buildings, furniture, cars
